53:1.text: By the star when it descends,

53:2.text: has not strayed, nor has he erred,

53:4.text: It is not but a revelation revealed,

53:5.text: Taught to him by one intense in strength

53:7.text: While he was in the higher

53:9.text: And was at a distance of two bow lengths or nearer.

53:10.text: And he revealed to His Servant

53:12.text: So will you dispute with him over what he saw?

53:13.text: And he certainly saw him in another descent

53:14.text: At the Lote Tree of the Utmost Boundary -

53:15.text: Near it is the Garden of Refuge

53:16.text: When there covered the Lote Tree that which covered

53:17.text: did not swerve, nor did it transgress

53:18.text: He certainly saw of the greatest signs of his Lord.

53:19.text: So have you considered al-Lāt and al-ʿUzzā?

53:20.text: And Manāt, the third - the other one?

53:21.text: Is the male for you and for Him the female?

53:22.text: That, then, is an unjust division.

53:23.text: names you have named them - you and your forefathers - for which Allāh has sent down no authority. They follow not except assumption and what
souls desire, and there has already come to them from their Lord guidance.

53:24.text: Or is there for man whatever he wishes?

53:25.text: Rather, to Allāh belongs the Hereafter and the first

53:26.text: And how many angels there are in the heavens whose intercession will not avail at all except
to whom He wills and approves.
